Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that the modern equivalent (the Scottish Parliament) has been based at The Mound since 2004. In reality, The Mound (General Assembly Hall) was the temporary location from 1999 until 2004; since 2004, the Scottish Parliament has been based at Holyrood (the Scottish Parliament Building). This factual error led directly to the wrong final answer.
